name: rentemester-imported-receivable-bank-settlements-v44
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_bank_settlements (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  receivable_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES imported_receivable_headers(id),
  bank_transaction_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bank_transactions(id),
  bank_transaction_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(bank_transaction_hash)=64),
  journal_entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES journal_entries(id),
  schedule_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0),
  effective_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(effective_date)=10),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(principal_kind, principal_subject_id, idempotency_key)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_bank_settlements_receivable_idx ON imported_receivable_bank_settlements(receivable_id, effective_date);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_bank_settlements_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON imported_receivable_bank_settlements BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivable bank settlements are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_bank_settlements_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON imported_receivable_bank_settlements BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivable bank settlements are append-only'); END;
